card.name: Small words in non-English running text
card.fires_on: Short grammar words (articles, prepositions, auxiliary verbs, plural endings) in Spanish, Italian, Indonesian, Dutch or French text, usually right before a noun or verb phrase.

modes.label: Spanish articles and endings
modes.description: The article las or a plural ending in a Spanish sentence about birds and plants.
modes.example: 6 de 7 especies de plant<<as>> perdieron todas sus flores, except

modes.label: Other-language linking words
modes.description: Short words like il, di, du or kunnen in Italian, Indonesian, French or Dutch text.
modes.example: I documenti depositati in UnissResearch sono protetti dalle leggi che regolano<< il>> diritto d'autore

card.writes: It promotes Chinese nouns such as clue, name, address and answer, and suppresses 'configured'-type English words, so it adds little of clear use.
card.plain: It fires on little grammar words in non-English text, just before the next noun or verb.
